connector.name: Vault MCP Tools
connector.registryDescription: Complete Obsidian vault MCP server. 35 tools: notes, search, graph, tags, canvas.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package vault-mcp-tools. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the afable702 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault root directory

env.name: OBSIDIAN_REST_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for the Obsidian REST API (enables 3 bonus tools: execute_command, list_commands, open_in_obsidian)

env.name: OBSIDIAN_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for HTTP transport authentication
